$comment: EXP-1175: the Run face's STATUS ROW and its Show work switch, mirrored x4 (web lib/work-faces.ts + lib/agent-feed.ts, iOS WorkFaces.swift + AgentFeed.swift, Android WorkFaces.kt + AgentFeed.kt, desktop run_rows.rs + steer feed.rs). The Run face opens as the THREAD (the status row over the run's published results, newest at the bottom, pending plan/question cards still in place) unless the viewer's per-user Show work preference (default showWorkDefault, remembered per user id on every client) is on, in which case the same row sits over the full transcript; the row's trailing text button reads showWorkLabel while the thread shows and hideWorkLabel while the transcript shows. runRowCaption({state, device, startedAt, endedAt, now}) = the row's first line + tone: working -> 'Building on <device> · <elapsed>' (elapsed = now - startedAt), ended -> 'Ended on <device> · <elapsed>' (elapsed = endedAt - startedAt; the caller passes ended_at, else updated_at), paused/needs_input/review/done = the session list row's status line words and tones. The elapsed ladder is the working caption's ('37s', '2m 04s', '1h 03m'); a missing or unparsable timestamp drops the ' · <elapsed>' part. lastToolLine(feed) = the row's muted second line: the NEWEST tool item of the feed (anything after it is ignored); an Exponential MCP tool reads the contract expToolDisplay caption for its settled state plus its subject (settled: the single preview ref's title, else identifier, else the preview title/identifier, else the call's detail; unsettled: the detail), any other tool its name plus its detail; both joined by ONE space, a missing part dropped; no tool item = null. Only a LIVE run shows the line.

captions.name: a working run says where it builds and for how long
hours and minutes past an hour
a clock that ran backwards reads 0s
an unparsable start drops the elapsed part
an ended run measures start to end
an ended run with no end stamp drops the elapsed part

toolLines.name: a plain tool reads name and detail
a plain tool without detail reads its name alone
the newest tool wins over anything after it
an unsettled Exponential tool reads the progressive caption and the call's subject
a settled Exponential tool reads the done caption and the answer's ref
toolLines.expected: Created issue Login button overlaps the logo

toolLines.name: a settled Exponential tool with no subject reads the caption alone
